aliases: University of Dallas / KDC Irving data center campus

location.site_description: North of State Highway 114 at Braniff Drive, near the University of Dallas main campus

status_detail: Irving zoning and comprehensive-plan changes for data-center use are City Council approved; project remains described by KDC as in design phase, and no matching recent construction permit record was found in Irving's public development-permit activity layer during this refresh.

actions.government_body: City of Irving Planning and Zoning Commission
actions.result_status: scheduled for 2024-07-11 City Council public hearing
actions.description: Comprehensive plan amendment for 1301 and 1351 E. John Carpenter Freeway, approximately 33.89 acres, from Urban Center and Open Space to Manufacturing/Warehouse.

actions.government_body: City of Irving Planning and Zoning Commission
actions.result_status: scheduled for 2024-07-11 City Council public hearing
actions.description: Zoning change for 1301 and 1351 E. John Carpenter Freeway, approximately 33.89 acres, from PUD 6 Tract G transit-oriented mixed use/office to S-P-2 (ML-20a) for data center uses, excluding certain ML-20a uses.
City public zoning layer lists request as S-P-2 for ML-20a & Data Center and status as City Council approved.
City public zoning layer lists the future land-use change to Manufacturing/Warehouse as City Council approved.
Later PUD 6 ordinance recites that Ordinance No. 2024-10970 approved Zoning Case 2024-205-ZC on 2024-07-11 and removed Tract G from PUD 6.

capacity_notes: No official MW capacity figure found. Public reports describe 770,000 square feet of planned data-center space and KDC states nearby Oncor transmission upgrades offer hyperscale-level power capacity, without quantifying MW.
owner: University of Dallas (land owner); KDC Real Estate Development & Investments (developer/applicant)

contradictions.description: Official Irving P&Z agenda and live zoning layer support approximately 33.89 acres for cases 2024-205-ZC and 2024-224-CP; some media reports describe a broader 67-acre development site. Treat 33.89 acres as the official case acreage unless a later city filing expands the project boundary.

history.note: First independent refresh converted seed-only record to official-local-government-supported zoning/design-phase project.
